title: Weight of a bond made through the field

key_results.statement: Lowest one-object eigenvalue with point terms $g_a$ through third order: $\varepsilon_0=-2Dt_f+\sum_a g_a/\mathcal X-\frac{1}{t_f\mathcal X}\sum g_ag_b\ell_{ab}+\frac{1}{t_f^2\mathcal X}[\sum g_ag_bg_c\ell_{ab}\ell_{bc}-\frac{\sum g_c}{\mathcal X}\sum g_ag_b\ell^{(2)}_{ab}]$, each further order smaller by a factor of order $\eta$.

Bond profile $E(x_1,\mathbf r)-E(x_1,\mathbf r')=[B(\mathbf r)-B(\mathbf r')](1+O(\eta))$, $B=-\frac{2ng_1g_2}{t_f}\ell(\mathbf r)$; fixed by one total contract, the same for both couplings and every A5 split; the zero of $B$ and the split into rest costs, own marks and bond are fixed only by comparing descriptions.

Tori: $\ell(0)-\ell(\mathbf r)=\frac{\ln|\mathbf r|}{2\pi}+\frac{2\gamma_E+3\ln2}{4\pi}+O(|\mathbf r|^{-2})-\frac{|\mathbf r|^2}{4L^2}$ ($D=2$), $=G_0-\frac{1}{4\pi|\mathbf r|}+O(|\mathbf r|^{-3})-\frac{|\mathbf r|^2}{6L^3}$ with $G_0=0.2527310$ ($D=3$).

Weight of one body: $W_i=ng_i\phi+\frac{ng_sg_i^2}{t_f^2}[2\ell_0\ell+\ell^2-\frac{2}{\mathcal X}\ell^{(2)}](x-x_s)$, $\phi=-\frac{2g_s}{t_f}\ell(x-x_s)$, on all three graphs, relative error $O(\eta^2)$.

Weight of the pair $W_1(x_1)+W_2(x_2)+W_b$ with $W_b=\frac{2ng_sg_1g_2}{t_f^2}[\ell(\mathbf r)(\ell_{1s}+\ell_{2s})+\ell_{1s}\ell_{2s}-\frac{\ell^{(2)}_{1s}+\ell^{(2)}_{2s}}{\mathcal X}]$, relative error $O(\eta)$.

$W_b=\frac12B(\mathbf r)[\phi(x_1)+\phi(x_2)]+\frac{ng_1g_2}{2g_s}\phi(x_1)\phi(x_2)$ minus a normalization term: the bond is weighed by the same $\phi$ as the first-order costs of the bodies, half at each body.

Exact rearrangement: $W_{\rm pair}=\mathcal C_{\rm p}(\mathbf r)\phi(x_1)+\frac{ng_s(g_1+g_2)^2}{t_f^2}[\ell(\mathbf R)^2-\frac{2\ell^{(2)}(\mathbf R)}{\mathcal X}]$ plus terms of first order in $\mathbf r\cdot\nabla\ell(\mathbf R)$; for $|\mathbf r|\ll d$ the coupling-made cost of the pair, bond included, is weighed by $\phi$.

Single body: level differences of weight equal level differences of cost times $F_i$ at leading order in $\eta$, with $F_i=\phi$ (full grip, the same for all levels, branches and bodies) and $F_i=\frac{n\gamma_i}{1+n\gamma_i}\phi$ (coupling (a)).

Full grip: the ratio of the bond's weight profile to bond profile times $F$ is $\rho_0(1+O(\eta))$ with $\rho_0=1+\kappa$ depending only on graph and places, not on levels, branches, $\gamma_i$, $N_f$, $t_f$ or the sign of the bond.

For $|\mathbf r|,|\mathbf r'|\ll d\ll L$, $\kappa$ is of first order in $\mathbf r/d$: $O(|\mathbf r'|/d)$ on the cubic torus, $O(\frac{|\mathbf r-\mathbf r'|}{d}\ln\frac{L^2}{|\mathbf r|d})$ on the square torus; it consists of the relocation of the midpoint at which the bond is weighed.

With the midpoint as the place: $\kappa^{\rm mid}=O(|\mathbf r||\mathbf r'|/d^2)$ (cubic), $O(\frac{|\mathbf r'|^2}{d^2}\ln\frac{L^2}{|\mathbf r'|d})$ (square), and $0$ on the ring at leading order in $\eta$; on the ring with place $x_1$, $\rho_0=\frac{2(1-w)(1-2w)}{(1-2u)(1-2v)}$; full grip: the bond is weighed like the costs (yes on the ring and cubic torus, on the square torus only for $d$ large against $|\mathbf r|$ times a logarithm of $L$).

Coupling (a): the ratio is $\frac{1+n\gamma_i}{n\gamma_i}$ times the full-grip ratio, so wherever the latter is 1 it is $>1$ on every graph: the bond is weighed more strongly than the level costs of the bodies.
Highest state (even $L$): $E^{\max}(g)=c-N_f\varepsilon_0(-g)$, so $B$, $\phi$, $F_i$ change sign, $W_b$ does not, and all ratios are unchanged.

bond function (bond profile up to a constant)
bond part of the weight of the pair
coupling-made cost of the pair through second order
first-order displacement part of the bond weight
function by which a single body's weight follows its cost
ratio of bond weight to bond profile times F (place x1)
ratio with the midpoint as the place of the pair

open_issues: Separations are those of field places; their relation to the distances of 03-ilang-space is not used.
The ratio depends on the place assigned to an extended pair (x1 against the midpoint); which place the fall of a pair tests is for the packages on mutual motion and inertia.
The O(η) dependence of the ratio on levels, branches and bodies is shown numerically only.
The torus estimates of κ and κ_mid are order estimates at generic places, checked numerically; they fail where the gradient of ℓ along the step vanishes.
Only held bodies and the lowest (or mirrored highest) field state are treated.
For coupling (a) the rest term is not weighed at this order; whether a wider class weighs it is not decided here.

consistency_checks.check: Dimensions of B, W_b, φ and the ratios
g_2 → 0 reduces the pair to body 1; on the cubic torus W_b vanishes as all separations grow (code: decay as L^-2)
Hellmann–Feynman sum rule: the g_1 g_2 part of the weight sums to zero over the place (analytic; code ≤ 1e-15)
